About EARN'M

THE EARN'M LOYALTY ECOSYSTEM

The $EARNM Coin and Mystery Boxes were developed to help people around the world benefit from the time spent on their devices. Whether it's through listening to music, playing games, or shopping online, EARN'M makes it possible to reward people for their everyday online activities. Learn more about the EARN'M Loyalty Ecosystem at earnm.com.

THIS dAPP

Now in its Alpha phase, the current version of the EARN'M dApp is the first of its kind — a financially sustainable Web3 airdrop & rewards solution.With built-in vesting & distribution mechanisms driven by their proprietary 'Fractal Box' protocol, EARN'M Mystery Boxes are fully customizable and can deployed in minutes to any Web2 or Web3 partner platform.

OTHER INFORMATION

The EARN'M Loyalty Ecosystem is the brainchild of Mode Mobile. In the last 4 years, Mode has raised $50M+ and empowered its users to earn and save over $250M!Consumers spend an average of 25% of their waking hours on devices and they deserve to get paid for it. EARN'M is the Web3 embodiment of that mission.
